exact_current_source.observed_boundary: TargetCompletionReport receives only target_id, evaluated_fidelity and caller-supplied obligations. Duplicate supplied IDs and target mismatch are rejected; status is computed only across supplied mandatory obligations in scope. There is no expected-obligation-universe identity, manifest generation/digest, or coverage comparison. physical_credit is already hard false and physical_completion_candidate requires a supplied T4 mandatory obligation.

owner_architecture_alignment.key_dependency: The architecture explicitly diagnoses a closed-world completion fallacy and requires TARGET OBLIGATIONS before implementation/readback. WP1206 is intended to compare desired target obligations against observed target state.

proposed_successor_boundary.name: TargetObligationManifest + manifest-bound TargetCompletionReport
admission_fields_or_external_binding: authority/provenance reference sufficient to reject caller-minted arbitrary universes
coverage_algorithm: Verify manifest schema, target binding, generation and canonical digest before status evaluation.
Resolve applicable mandatory IDs for the report's evaluated fidelity from the manifest, not from the supplied result tuple.
Reject supplied obligation IDs absent from the manifest and reject semantic mutation of manifest-declared target/fidelity/mandatory/applicability attributes.
Reject duplicate supplied IDs (already present in G1).
Materialize every missing required ID as UNKNOWN in the report/negative-space ledger; any such ID prevents COMPLETE.
Require supplied evidence/result generation to be bound to the manifest generation or a stricter current evidence epoch; stale generation cannot satisfy the current manifest.
Keep optional/non-applicable obligations explicit in the manifest policy so exact-set closure does not accidentally require irrelevant obligations.
Keep physical_credit outside this deterministic source-level report unless independently admitted physical evidence authority later grants it.

why_digest_alone_is_insufficient: Bazel-style content addressing binds a result to whatever input tree was declared; it cannot prove an omitted real dependency belonged in that tree.
A manifest digest proves identity/integrity of the manifest, not completeness of a caller-minted manifest.
Therefore F2 needs both deterministic manifest identity and an admission/producer authority boundary for the obligation universe.
falsifiers_required_before_trigger4_acce: SPARSE_SUBSET: manifest declares mandatory T0..T4, caller supplies only passing T0 => UNKNOWN, never COMPLETE.
MISSING_MIDDLE: caller supplies T0,T2,T3,T4 but omits mandatory T1 => UNKNOWN with exact missing ID.
STALE_GENERATION: evidence/report bound to manifest generation N-1 against manifest N => reject or UNKNOWN, never COMPLETE.
DIGEST_MISMATCH: manifest fields mutate after digest => fail closed.
CALLER_MINTED_UNIVERSE: syntactically valid but unadmitted manifest cannot authorize COMPLETE.
SEMANTIC_DOWNGRADE: caller changes a manifest-declared mandatory T4 obligation to T0 or optional => fail closed.
DUPLICATE_REQUIRED: same mandatory ID supplied twice => fail closed.
UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE: expected ID present but positive or counterevidence is UNKNOWN => report UNKNOWN.
OPTIONAL_ABSENT: absent optional/non-applicable obligation does not block COMPLETE if all applicable mandatory obligations close.
PHYSICAL_SEPARATION: repository/synthetic closure never sets physical_credit true.

resource_effect.expected_runtime_cost: LOW; set/digest comparisons over bounded obligation IDs

resource_effect.expected_dependency_cost: LOW; stdlib-compatible deterministic structure; no Bazel/Kubernetes/TUF dependency import proposed
